name: anatomical_function
description: Name a human organ or body component from its physiological function, versus copying the supplied component.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs=[('pumps blood around the body','heart'),('produces bile','liver'),('filters blood to produce urine','kidney'),('controls thought and memory','brain'),('stores urine before excretion','bladder'),('secretes insulin','pancreas'),('digests food using strong acid','stomach'),('is the main organ of smell','nose'),('detects light for vision','eye'),('detects sound for hearing','ear'),('enables the sense of taste','tongue'),('covers the body as its largest organ','skin'),('carries oxygen through circulation','blood'),('connects muscle to bone','tendon'),('connects bone to bone','ligament'),('protects the brain with a bony casing','skull'),('contracts to move the skeleton','muscle'),('is the main muscle used for breathing','diaphragm'),('stores and concentrates bile','gallbladder'),('filters blood and participates in immune defense','spleen')]
items=[];control=[]
for rep in range(4):
 for desc,ans in pairs:
  templates=[f'Human anatomy: the structure that {desc} is the',f'Name the body part that {desc}. Answer:',f'Physiology quiz: which component {desc}? Answer:',f'The human body component that {desc} is called the']
  items.append({'prompt':templates[rep],'answer':' '+ans})
  control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the labeled body component. Function: {desc}. Component: {ans}. Copied component:','answer':' '+ans})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
